summary_1line: After Rama devastates the Rakshasa armies, the Titan women mourn their dead and blame Shurpanakha and Ravana’s arrogance for Lanka’s ruin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rakshasa women gather among fields of fallen elephants, shattered chariots, and slain warriors, wailing over their dead beneath the smoky sky of Lanka.
A circle of grieving Titan women, hair disheveled and arms raised, curse Shurpanakha while the burning battlefield glows behind them.
The devastated battlefield stretches with thousands of fallen elephants, horses, and chariots pierced by Rama’s golden-feathered arrows.
